purpose: Describe a gradual change over time.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
As I practiced, I gradually gained confidence.
The sounds of the town gradually faded into the distance.
restrictions: Highlights incremental development, not an immediate jump.
mistake: Do not confuse the adverb 次第に with dependency marker 次第で.
